critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /employees/{id}/installed ignores request body (always toggles). Function signature declares body_installed=True but reads current state and flips it. This is fine for the UI toggle but could be surprising if an admin ever wants to force a specific state via API. Consider accepting an optional {installed: bool} body.

server.py _ps_signatures_block bypasses newline handling only for \r/\n but the here-string uses @'...'@ which is a single-quoted here-string in PowerShell — variables/backticks won't be expanded, which is intentional and safe for HTML with $ chars. Good.
GET /send-log has no pagination and caps at 200 entries — fine for MVP; consider ?limit/?offset later.

PUT /employees/{id}/installed uses ObjectId(emp_id) without validation; passing a non-24-hex id triggers a 500 (bson.errors.InvalidId). Wrap in try/except -> 400. Same pattern in delete_employee/update_employee.
M365Deploy.jsx uses axios blob response; ensure no auth token is logged. Not a bug, just a note.
